title: Encoding a flipped binary neighbor
statement: Let $m$ be a positive natural number and let $w$ be a Boolean vector of length $2m$. Encoding the Boolean vector obtained by the inner-product flip-neighbor operation gives exactly the binary vector obtained by applying the corresponding operation over $\mathbb F_2$ to the encoding of $w$.
hypotheses_covered: m is a positive natural number
w is a Boolean vector of length 2m
